## Data and materials

- The canonical identifiers and official titles are defined in the [course registry](https://github.com/fs-ise/handbook/blob/main/data/courses.yml){target=_blank}.
- Semester-specific course offerings are [here](https://github.com/fs-ise/handbook/tree/main/teaching/courses){target=_blank}. Historical filenames and `title_short` values remain valid aliases; new records use the registry's uppercase `course_id`.
- Materials are [here](/teaching/materials.html).
- Conformance with standards: see [overview](repository_setup.html#repository-conformance-overview)
